title: Exact Sampling of Permutations with a Fixed Longest Increasing Subsequence
summary: We study exact uniform sampling of permutations of length $n$ whose longest increasing subsequence (LIS) has prescribed length $k$. Our main result is, to the best of our knowledge, the first polynomial-time exact sampler for this problem, valid for every $1\le k\le n$. Via the Robinson--Schensted correspondence the problem reduces to sampling a Young diagram with first row of length $k$ from the hook-length-squared (conditioned Plancherel) law.
